title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Six-keyword rotation against We Work Remotely, region eligibility confirmed from each posting's own detail page (the site's generic 'Anywhere in the World' tag is not trustworthy on its own).
latest_update: Checked September 21, 2026 — 7 postings opened and read in full across 4 keywords with results (2 keywords returned zero); 2 known pipeline postings, 2 new scored rows, 1 reviewed-then-ineligible (timezone gate), 2 reviewed-then-out-of-scope.

rows.title: Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer
rows.gap: Customer-facing CI/CD/DevOps implementation role — direct overlap with Marc's Artifactory/CI-CD consulting background. None material.

rows.title: Professional Services DevOps Engineer
rows.location: "Open to remote within the East Coast only" — explicit US East Coast region restriction, stated at the top of the full posting; excludes Canada. Distinct from JFrog's Senior req (already Applied), which is explicitly Canada-GeoLocked.
rows.gap: Same customer-facing CI/CD/DevOps profile as JFrog's Senior req Marc already applied to, but this req's own posting text restricts remote work to the US East Coast — not take-able from Ontario. Corrected 2026-09-21: the initial run's location field missed this line and scored it 7/New; re-verified directly on the posting before filing.

rows.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
rows.location: Remote — EU, US, Canada, UK, Australia, Singapore (freelance marketplace, no visa assistance)
rows.gap: Requires 3+ years Kubernetes and Python/Golang — Marc has no Golang experience and his Kubernetes depth is provisioning-level, not the deep administration this listing implies.

rows.title: Senior Platform Engineer
rows.location: Remote, Anywhere in the World (client engagement via Proxify)
rows.gap: Requires expert-level Kubernetes operator/controller development plus strong Go or Python for building custom platform tooling — beyond Marc's provisioning-level Kubernetes depth (CKA in progress, not complete) and he has no Go experience.

rows.title: Senior Cloud Engineer (Azure)
rows.location: CET timezone ±3hrs only — explicitly excludes other timezones despite the "Anywhere in the World" region tag
rows.gap: Full posting states "we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other timezones" outside CET±3 — excludes Canada/Eastern entirely. Real Azure/Terraform/AKS fit otherwise, but not take-able.

rows.title: Cloud Security Engineer
rows.gap: Cloud security specialist role (AWS security services, CNAPP/SIEM tooling, security certs) — not DevOps/Platform/SRE center of gravity; Marc has no claimed cloud-security-specialist depth.

rows.title: AI Engineer - FDE (Forward Deployed Engineer)
rows.gap: Application-layer GenAI engineering (RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning) requiring a graduate degree in a quantitative discipline — not infrastructure/DevOps work despite the Forward Deployed Engineer title.

notes_sections.heading: Query audit
items: DevOps Engineer — ~9 listings shown, 8 reviewed within boundary; 3 plausible (both JFrog reqs, Lemon.io). Complete.
Platform Engineer — 4 listings shown (one duplicate LawnStarter posting); 1 plausible (Proxify AB Senior Platform Engineer). Complete.
Cloud Engineer — 2 listings shown across two passes (Proxify AB Senior Cloud Engineer, Hex Technologies Cloud Security Engineer); both opened and reviewed in full. Complete.
Forward Deployed Engineer — 1 listing shown (Databricks AI Engineer - FDE), reviewed in full. Complete.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: No CAPTCHA or blocking challenge encountered.

Confirmed the skill's warning about wrong-<article>-element extraction on detail pages: a naive page-text read grabs the "Related Jobs" sidebar instead of the real description on at least one JFrog listing. Located and read the actual job-description region for every posting instead.

Correction (2026-09-21, during addjob filing): JFrog's non-Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer req was re-verified before filing and found to state "Open to remote within the East Coast only" at the top of its full posting — a US-only region restriction the original run's location field missed. Re-scored from 7/New to -1/Ineligible; not filed to applications.md.
All retrieval was read-only; no application, account, "AI Auto-Apply," or form action was used.

method: Six default keyword queries run independently via browser against weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/search. Two returned zero results (Site Reliability Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer). Across the remaining four, 7 distinct postings were opened and read in full (region tag never trusted alone — confirmed from each posting's own detail page): 2 are known pipeline postings (JFrog Senior Professional Services DevOps Engineer — Applied; Lemon.io Senior DevOps Engineer — Skipped), 2 are new in-scope scored postings, 1 was reviewed in full and found region-ineligible (CET-timezone-only restriction hidden behind an "Anywhere in the World" tag), and 2 were reviewed in full and found out of scope (cloud security specialist; application-layer GenAI engineering).
